critical_code_review_comments: tr_compliance.auto_issue_on_checkout uses asyncio.create_task in bookings.py checkout hook — fire-and-forget with no retry; if task fails silently the guest doesn't get the invoice email. Consider adding a periodic retry sweep on log.status=='failed' entries.

site_builder.campaign_short_link inserts into db.campaign_clicks synchronously before returning 302. On viral campaigns this could become a hot write; consider batched inserts or a bloom filter for bot ch=other spam. Also referrer/UA are stored — GDPR concern (add hashing or IP anonymization).

site_builder.public/c/{code}/qr.png builds URL using request.base_url (falls back if PUBLIC_BASE_URL missing) but doesn't validate the constructed URL length; qrcode.make will fail on absurd inputs — currently code is short so OK.
arrival_reminder._upsells: favorite detection uses guest_email exact match — will miss guests who booked with different email/spelling. Consider guest_phone or normalized email fallback.
arrival_reminder: whatsapp is only a mocked write to whatsapp_outbox; no actual Twilio/360dialog integration. Fine for QA but must not ship prod as-is.

housekeeping.update_room_status 409 conflict correctly checks base_updated_at > cur.updated_at AND status change; but doesn't emit any real-time notification (WebSocket) to the offline client to retry. PWA relies on manual sync click for conflict recovery.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 features validated end-to-end; HK PWA queue-and-sync from card sheet observed at bar/cache/reload level; sheet-open transition not exercised due to hk-room-* selector matching the filter chip first but offline bar, cache-render and auto-sync-online verified)
